description: Edit a roadmap item's status or override the search-data reconcile. Pass EITHER `action` (a shortcut) OR `status` directly — the server requires at least one. `action` shortcuts: "ignore" (dismiss the suggestion, status -> ignored, stamps ignoredAt), "restore" (ONLY for hidden/ignored items: returns 409 on any other status, so completed work is never reopened; status -> suggested, clears ignoredAt; if the reconcile had hidden it as already covered it also stays visible on later reconcile runs), "start" (status -> in_progress, clears ignoredAt/completedAt), "complete" (status -> completed, stamps completedAt). Sticky overrides the weekly reconcile always respects: "pin" (suggested items only: the reconcile will not re-rank it), "unpin" (let it re-rank again), "remove" (hide it and never re-create it - use for a keyword or topic the user does not want). "start" on a type="refresh" item now CREATES A REFRESH BRIEF (it does not rewrite anything yet): same as seo_roadmap_create_brief. Poll get_job on the returned operationId, review the brief with seo_get_brief (kind="refresh", changes[]), then approve it with seo_approve_briefs - THAT approval rewrites the existing article in place (blog articles only). Confirm with the user before approving. There is no title or priority field on this endpoint — the roadmap item's title and priority cannot be edited via this tool (or the underlying server route at all).

action.description: Shortcut: ignore -> ignored, restore -> suggested (hidden/ignored items only, else 409; stays visible), start -> in_progress (a refresh item: rewrites its page, returns operationId), complete -> completed, pin/unpin -> freeze/unfreeze the item's rank, remove -> hide permanently.

status.description: Set the status directly. Omit if using `action` instead.

name: seo_roadmap_edit
